escalations.formula: Escalation connections taken in the run: a raise to the lead or to the owner.

spec-rework.formula: Times the spec was reopened after spec-check had passed it.

acceptance-coverage.formula: Criteria in the approved item that have at least one acceptance test, divided by all criteria in the item.

red-for-wrong-reason.formula: Red runs in which the new test failed on a compile error, an import error or a timeout instead of an assertion.

acceptance-rounds.formula: Build rounds until the acceptance suite is green.

defects-found-in-review.formula: Review findings that the verdict upheld.

defects-escaped.formula: Defects filed against a merged change within 30 days of the merge.

lead-time.formula: Merge time minus the time of work-item-ready.

decision-latency.formula: Time from the gate opening to the signed decision.

write-set-collisions.formula: Pairs of units in the cut whose write-sets share at least one file.

review-rounds.formula: Review rounds until the verdict approves the change.

report-complete.formula: Required sections present in the final report, divided by all required sections.

proposals-accepted.formula: Improver proposals that the owner accepted, divided by all proposals made.

tests-per-unit.formula: Tests added or changed in a unit.

diff-lines.formula: Lines added plus lines removed in a unit.

green-rounds.formula: Green rounds until the suite passes with no test file touched.
